dedupe_keys.name: dataset occupancy presence and trajectory dataset from an instrumented public building

description: A University of Southern Denmark team publishes presence and movement trajectories from an instrumented public building. Zenodo supplies a full archive and sample archive under CC BY 4.0. Three stereo-vision cameras recorded about 5.49 million readings over thirteen summer days in 2019 within a 105-square-metre monitored space. The described CSV includes time, day type, x and y position, occupant identifier, estimated height and camera identifier. These observations can calibrate people-flow and occupancy components in building evacuation or indoor-environment simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this sequence. Coverage is one small monitored space and a short summer period, not long-term public-building demand. A limitation is that camera-derived tracks can have missed detections or identity switches, and the public description does not quantify these errors. The occupant identifier is a sensor label, not a verified person identity. No archive was downloaded or tracking quality independently checked.
